leagues.title: Competitions
leagues.description: Which competitions to return. Premier League and LaLiga are volunteer-maintained and recent results can arrive days late; the German leagues, European cups and hockey are kept fully up to date.

range.title: Which matches
range.description: "Live now" returns only matches in progress, and is empty when nothing is being played.

dateFrom.title: From date (custom)
dateFrom.description: YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. Used when "Which matches" is Custom dates.

statuses.title: Match status
statuses.description: Keep only matches in these states. All by default.

team.title: Team filter
team.description: Only matches involving a team whose name contains this text, e.g. "Bayern" or "Dortmund".

mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Monitor: only matches whose score or status changed since the last run
mode.description: Schedule monitor mode during match days to get goal and full-time alerts.

monitorStoreName.title: Monitor memory name
monitorStoreName.description: Key-value store that holds the previous scores. Use a different name for each separate monitor.

maxMatches.title: Max matches
maxMatches.description: Stop after this many matches, earliest kickoff first.
